title: Cross-source consistency audit for 225Ra/225Ac parity-doublet artifacts

checks.finding: parity-doublet-e1-unit-boundary.md says the Ra E1 field has a 225Ra beta-minus/conversion-electron provenance; the archived 225Ra ENSDF L31.56 annotation instead says the level lifetime came from (alpha)(ce)(t) in 229Th alpha decay (1985Is03). The numeric BE1W field is intact; only the provenance sentence is inconsistent.

adjudication: No numerical contradiction found in hashes, W.u. conversion, reduced-matrix convention, direction degeneracy, CG², conditional D0, or window candidate counts.
The Ra E1 provenance wording in parity-doublet-e1-unit-boundary.md needs review against the raw evaluation annotation; no existing file was edited in this unit.
All D0 values remain conditional rotor inferences with unresolved sign, not direct observables.
Nearest-level and energy-window candidates remain bookkeeping outputs, not accepted physical band pairings.
